thread:
maria: Quick sync — we need a concise explainability UI for service-account credential routing when fallbacks occur. PMs keep getting support tickets saying 'why did my request use a cheaper model?'.

 tom: +1. users want a single-line reason in the console, not a dump of policies.

 jyoti: Can we show the decision chain? e.g. `requested model -> routing policy -> shard availability -> fallback model`. One line summary + optional details.

 oliver: agree on summary + details. also we need to annotate logs with a short code so infra can join traces: `route_code=SA_FALLBACK_Q` or `route_code=LATENCY_ZONE_2` so SREs can filter.

 anna: support: please avoid exposing internal policy names to customers. the copy must be understandable: e.g., "Routed to compact-quantized model due to capacity constraints in your reserved pool" not `pool_east_3_overcommit`.

 maria: yes — UX copy needs product review. propose fields: `reason_summary`, `reason_code`, `meta` (internal). Console shows reason_summary to user, reason_code in audit logs.

 sam: telemetry ask: add `routing_explain_sample=true` for 1% of requests with full details. otherwise only store summary + reason_code. sampling avoids bill shock.

 jyoti: Implementation detail — for sampled requests we include `explain_payload` in request logs with KV cache state snapshot and selected policies. Example payload (for sampled):

```json
{
  "requested_model": "redwood-large-v1",
  "selected_model": "redwood-quant-cpu-1",
  "route_code": "CAPACITY_FALLBACK",
  "policy_path": ["latency_primary","dedicated_capacity_fallback"],
  "timestamp": "2024-11-03T16:22:01Z"
}
```

 oliver: +1 but ensure we redact tenant-specific identifiers for privacy when showing in the console. Audit logs (enterprise) still keep full context.

 tom: Console UX — placement idea: in the per-request detail flyout, add a "Routing" section with: 1) short sentence, 2) small inline pill showing `route_code`, 3) link "Why this happened" opening details panel (only for sampled or enterprise customers).

 anna: for rollout, let's A/B test two copy variants: "capacity" vs "latency" framing. We should measure support ticket reduction and NPS on affected customers.

 maria: rollout plan sketch: feature flag `sa_routing_explain_v1` default off. Stage 1: internal + enterprise customers (1 week). Stage 2: 1% public sampling with `routing_explain_sample`. Stage 3: expand to 10% and then GA.

 sam: metric list: `routing_explain_view_rate`, `support_ticket_after_explain`, `avg_time_to_resolve`, `explain_sample_rate`. We'll need dashboards.

 oliver: infra notes: add lightweight route_code in request headers: `X-Route-Code: CAPACITY_FALLBACK`. This avoids fetching full explain payload for non-sampled flows.

 jyoti: API contract change: new optional field in response `routing` object. Minimal shape for non-sampled: `{ "reason_summary": "...", "reason_code": "CAPACITY_FALLBACK" }`. For sampled: add `explain_payload` (stringified). We'll keep field optional to avoid SDK churn.

 anna: product concern — docs team needs exact copy & allowed translations. i'll own the copy variants.

 tom: ops question — do we want this for keys tied to org vs project vs service account? My vote: show it whenever request is authenticated with any SA/org key, but reason_code should indicate attribution (ORG_POOL vs PROJECT_POOL vs SA_POOL).

 maria: agreed. include `attribution` in reason_code or separate `attribution` field in explain_payload. keep console summary neutral.

 infra-bot: deploy-checklist: 1) schema bump curated in API spec, 2) ff gate `sa_routing_explain_v1`, 3) telemetry schema update, 4) dashboard stub, 5) docs PR.

 sam: plus: add rate-limits on sampled explain_payload retention to avoid storage explosion. retention policy: sampled raw payloads expire after 30 days by default.

 jyoti: will prototype with a small middleware that computes reason_summary + reason_code and toggles `explain_payload` when sampling flag true. will send a mini RFC with API snippets.

 maria: thanks — can you add a proposed console mock in that RFC and list exact telemetry keys? i'll schedule a 30m sync tomorrow to align with product + docs. :calendar: 

 anna: great. tagging @support-lead in the sync invite for early feedback. :thumbsup:

 tom: sounds good. one last ask — make sure the public API docs have guidance for customers: "how to interpret route codes" and a link to rollback playbook if they prefer strict model pinning.

 maria: yep. pinning is separate but we'll surface it in the "Why this happened" details with one-click link to pin model/version.

 oliver: thanks everyone — moving this to the RFC thread once jyoti posts the draft.

 infra-bot: created issue #RFC-1029: `sa-routing-explainability` (assigned: jyoti).
